column4: 🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — 🇧🇷 the first Blackboard Ultra agent on these shelves for a BRAZILIAN PRIVATE university group.** CLI + read-only MCP for Cruzeiro do Sul / Unipê. 🔵 Every LATAM row before it was a public federal/state institution on SIGAA; this is the private-sector half of the same market, and Cruzeiro do Sul is one of Brazil's largest private groups. Declared unofficial.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the MOST-FORKED SIGAA repository this base has measured** (`34★`, `5` forks), and it was named in `repos/trending.md` without ever reaching a shelf. 🇧🇷 Tooling over the SIGAA portal.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇧🇷 SIGAA augmentation, `3★`. Authored by a named academic rather than a student account — the only SIGAA row here with that provenance.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇧🇷 Generates an `.ics` calendar from a UFAL SIGAA enrolment certificate. 🔵 **The cheapest useful integration shape in the whole LATAM tier: no API, no scraping session — it parses the document the registrar already hands the student.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇧🇷 Chrome extension theming the CEFET-MG SIGAA portal, `10★`. 🔴 **Not an agent and shelved as what it is:** evidence of the SIGAA front-end extension layer that sits beneath the MCP layer and supplies its DOM knowledge.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the Q-ACADÊMICO leg, which this base had named and never shelved.** 🇧🇷 Android client for the academic system used across the Institutos Federais. Apache-2.0, `6★`.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇺🇸 Lamakū (UH Mānoa D2L Brightspace). 🔵 **Writes as well as reads** — pages, media, discussions, assignments, course packages — and its README raises FERPA directly, which no other D2L row in this cohort does.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇺🇸 RIT myCourses (D2L). 🔴 **Submits assignments and posts to discussions — a WRITE posture on a student's own account**, the risk shape `P?` contrasts against read-only peers.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇨🇦 Waterloo D2L plus Piazza in one surface — the only row here that joins the LMS to the course Q&A system.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇨🇦 Memorial University (MUN) Brightspace, Apache-2.0, declared read-only.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the AGGREGATION shape.** 🇺🇸 Pulls every deadline from Purdue Brightspace *and* Gradescope, Pearson MyLab, WileyPLUS and ALEKS onto one page. 🔵 **The only row in this cohort that treats the courseware vendors, not the LMS, as the system of record — which is what a US undergraduate's week actually looks like.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the VENDOR's own components, from D2L itself** (🇨🇦 Kitchener). Apache-2.0, `81★`, `32` forks. 🔵 **Accessible web components for building Brightspace applications: the supported way to put a studio-built surface inside the LMS instead of beside it.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇩🇰 DTU Learn (Brightspace) + **Panopto lecture transcripts** — the only row here that reaches the lecture-capture system, which is where the course's actual content lives.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇫🇷 EDHEC: Blackboard + Aurion (the French higher-ed scheduling/SIS suite) + ePrinting + campus food in one server. 🔵 **Aurion is a FRENCH SIS brand this base had never recorded.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇬🇧 University of Glasgow Moodle. 🔵 **Mirrors the course into LOCAL FILES rather than serving tools** — the shape that works when the agent client cannot hold a session.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇩🇪 TUM: Moodle + **Artemis** (TUM's own open interactive-learning platform) + TUM Live + TUMonline. 🔵 **Four institutional systems behind one surface, and Artemis is itself open source — a build target, not just a source.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇵🇱 **USOS** — the Polish university administration system shared across most national HEIs — plus Moodle, an OR-Tools weekly planner and a job queue with verification. 🔵 **USOS is a national-scale system brand new to this base.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇭🇷 Merlin (SRCE Moodle), the Croatian national academic computing centre's LMS. 🔵 **Phone-approved sends: a human confirmation step on every outbound message** — a control, not a prompt instruction.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇧🇦 International Burch University (Sarajevo) SIS: grades, attendance, exams, tuition. 🔵 **Tuition balance is financial data — the first row on these shelves whose scope crosses from academic into bursar records.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇦🇪 UAE University Blackboard, with local SSO and **tools for INSTRUCTORS as well as students** — the staff-side posture is rare in this cohort.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`), and it is the named counter-instance to `T96`.** An MIT agent skill for TAs: rubric grading, parallel cheap graders, AI-and-copy detection, **Arabic feedback**, Moodle CSV export. 🔴 `0★`, single author, lab-scale — so it refines `T96` rather than overturning it: the grading supply is still thin, but it is no longer ALL licence-conflicted.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇺🇿 Faroz, an Uzbek children's education platform: courses, exercises, games, homework, over **remote MCP with OAuth**. 🔵 **A remote, OAuth-protected MCP against a commercial K-12 platform — the deployment shape most LATAM/EMEA ministries would actually procure, and the only one of its kind here.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇱🇰 SLIIT Courseweb (Moodle), Sri Lanka, `7★` / `3` forks.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇯🇵 Tokyo University of Technology Moodle, local read-only.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇨🇳 USTC Blackboard, local MCP, including coursework download and **assignment submission**.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the FORMS leg, and it is a jurisdiction-specific one.** 🇰🇷 Fills Korean government and school **HWP** (Hancom) forms end-to-end. 🔵 **HWP is the mandatory document format for Korean public-sector paperwork; no non-Korean toolchain speaks it. A Korean education engagement inherits this dependency whether or not it wants it.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇭🇰 Edge-to-cloud multimodal classroom agent and **exam invigilation**: client-side MediaPipe, LiteRT Whisper and Gemma with Gemini. 🔴 **Invigilation is proctoring — in EMEA it is Annex III territory and emotion inference is banned outright, so this is a row to study, not to deploy unmodified.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** 🇮🇳 Deterministic, auto-graded environments for agents on Indian-reality tasks (UPI, GST, forms, Hindi/Hinglish). 🔵 **Rule-based grading, not model-graded — which is exactly the arithmetic-outside-the-model principle `P67` prescribes, already implemented and Apache-2.0.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — field `NOASSERTION`, bytes MIT.** A `T27` rescue. Scopes itself to what is actually outstanding rather than dumping the whole course list.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** D2L Brightspace from Claude Code: courses, assignments, grades, content.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** D2L Brightspace **in Go** — the only compiled-language D2L server in this cohort, which matters for a single-binary campus deployment.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Unofficial read-only Brightspace command-line client.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** D2L course access over MCP, `7★` / `2` forks.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — field `NOASSERTION`, bytes MIT.** A second `T27` rescue, and the only server here covering **both D2L and Canvas** behind one interface.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Syncs Brightspace into **local SQLite plus files** so answers can be verified against the real course material. 🔵 **A grounding/citation posture rather than a tool-call posture.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the most-starred independent Blackboard server found** (`9★`). Local-first, read-only, reads only the signed-in student's own Blackboard Ultra data.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`), and the best-engineered row in this cohort.** Wraps the Blackboard Learn REST API; **RBAC middleware for role-based access**, CI, and a published `93.7%` coverage figure. 🔵 **Role-based access enforced in middleware is the control an institution-wide (rather than student-owned) deployment requires.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Local Blackboard Ultra access for any MCP client: courses, materials, deadlines, announcements.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Local **Playwright** MCP for Blackboard Learn with configurable institutions, SSO and academic calendars. 🔵 **Browser-driven, so it works where no REST credentials are issued — the usual case for a student.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Blackboard Learn Ultra over the **public REST API** rather than a scraped session. 🔴 **Institution behind the `ucsc` abbreviation NOT resolved this pass and deliberately not guessed; placed `Global` until read.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the widest Google-for-Education surface here:** Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Drive **and** Classroom in one server. 🔵 **Forms plus Classroom is the assessment path; most Classroom rows stop at coursework.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Apache-2.0. Brings authorized Google Classroom course and coursework context to **ChatGPT** over MCP — one of the few rows not targeting Claude first.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Google Classroom for Claude, Codex and Cursor. **Single Python file, no dependencies** — the lowest-friction row to audit before a pilot.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Google Classroom, student-scoped, read-only.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Google Classroom MCP, `2★`.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Google Classroom with **multiple Google accounts** — the practical case for a teacher who holds a personal and an institutional identity.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Read-only Google Classroom: to-do, due dates, missing work, grades, announcements.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — and it is a TEACHER-side row, in Spanish.** Creates assignments, materials, topics and announcements; install guide in Spanish. 🔵 **Named in `agents/trending.md` since an earlier pass and never shelved. The teacher-authoring posture is scarce and the Spanish-language documentation makes it directly reusable in a LATAM or Spanish engagement.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Moodle account access incl. **homework submission** — a write posture.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Moodle: courses, materials, assignments, deadlines, grades, quizzes, forums.
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Moodle reading **and authoring** of course content, company-maintained.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Moodle agent as a **local-first Chrome side panel**: read-only, no backend, no telemetry, declared integrity-safe. 🔵 **Zero-backend is the posture that clears a school's data-protection review fastest.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** An agent **skill** (not a server) for deadlines, assignments, materials and grades on any Moodle site, `4★`.

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — a BUILD-SIDE agent, which is a category this shelf barely holds.** Scaffolds a new Moodle plugin project with a `CLAUDE.md` context layer and code skeleton. 🔵 **Most rows here READ the LMS; this one EXTENDS it, which is what a studio engagement actually delivers.**
🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Reviews Moodle plugin changes against Moodle's own coding, security and API conventions before commit. 🔵 **Pairs with the scaffold above as a build-and-gate pair.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the largest build-safe engine found this pass** (Apache-2.0, `394★`, `132` forks, 🇩🇪 Labs.ai). Config-driven: JSON becomes a production agent. Multi-agent orchestration, 19+ LLM providers, MCP/A2A, RAG, persistent state. 🔵 **Not education-specific, which is the point — it is the orchestration layer the education rows above can be mounted on without writing one.**

🟢 **Filed this pass (`p828`) — the UPSTREAM of the Brazilian SIGAA cluster**, MIT, `61★`, `22` forks. 🔴 **STALE: last push `2024-04-10`, ~19 months before this pass**, and `heitorsDev/sigaa-ifsc-mcp` states it ported navigation and extraction from here. 🔵 **The whole LATAM SIGAA tier's lineage traces to one unmaintained MIT library. Adopting the tier means inheriting it — and maintaining it is a small, high-leverage, nameable deliverable.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — the SGA↔Moodle MIDDLEWARE leg.** 🇧🇷 IFRN. Connects academic management systems to Moodle: **SUAP** natively, plus a generic SGA profile for SIGAA and Q-Acadêmico. 🔴 **README declares it development-use-only at IFRN.** 🔵 **It is nonetheless the only artefact on these shelves that joins the Brazilian system of record to the LMS — the exact seam a Brazilian engagement sits on.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** Apache-2.0. Queries 1,500+ OECD statistical datasets (education among them) over the OECD SDMX API. 🔵 **A first-hand route to the OECD education indicators this base has had to cite second-hand.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`).** **Provenance-first** MCP for UNESCO UIS statistics, remote on Cloudflare Workers. 🔵 **Provenance-first means every figure carries its source — the property that makes a statistic usable in a client deliverable.**

🟢 **New this pass (`p828`) — an AI-NATIVE LMS, MIT, `109★` / `30` forks** (🇵🇱 Selleo). Self-hosted, positioned against Moodle, Docebo, TalentLMS, Thinkific, Teachable and Open edX, with an AI Mentor and role-play built in. 🔵 **Every other LMS on this shelf is GPL/AGPL. A permissively-licensed, AI-native LMS is rare enough to be a strategic option on its own: it can be forked and shipped commercially, which Moodle and Open edX cannot.**
